description: Validate AMPscript code for syntax errors, unknown functions, arity mismatches, and style issues. Returns a list of diagnostics with line numbers and severity. Set target to 'next' to also report functions not supported in Marketing Cloud Next.

code.description: The AMPscript code to validate. May include HTML context.

maxProblems.description: Maximum number of problems to return (default 100).

target.description: Target platform. Use 'next' to flag AMPscript functions not supported in Marketing Cloud Next.

name: validate_ampscript
